critical_code_review_comments: kids_consent.py POST /parental-consent: granting starting_stock_coins is gated on `not kid.get('starting_stock_coins')` — fine, but note that if a manual admin pre-set starting_stock_coins>0 the consent flow will silently skip the grant. Acceptable for V1-β but worth a comment.

kids_consent.py resend_consent: silently swallows email-send exceptions — by design (no enumeration), but the new token IS minted regardless of email success, so a parent who doesn't get the email can't differentiate from a broken send. Consider logging at WARN at least.

kids_journal.py daily-cap counts journals with bonus_awarded_sc>0 AND bonus_award_day==today. The day boundary uses UTC; for a kid in PST the cap can roll over at 4pm local. Acceptable design choice but document in user-facing copy if needed.

kids_auth.py /signup: parent_email is lowercased+stripped only if truthy; the existing-account 409 check uses lowercased email but doesn't trim whitespace from input email before the dup query. Edge case: user types 'kid@x.io ' — stored as 'kid@x.io' (good) and queried as 'kid@x.io' (good after .strip()). Already correct; no action.

Frontend KidsTradeJournalModal: submit button bbox at y=778.5+45.5=824, badge at y=840. Only ~16px gap on 414x896. Tighter mobile devices (e.g. 375x667) may not have been tested — recommend visual QA at iPhone SE size. Did not block on this since 414 is the request's spec viewport.

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects. Two false-positives during test development: (1) initial async tests failed because pytest-asyncio not installed → switched to sync pymongo; (2) trade fixture failed because TradeBody requires Literal['BUY','SELL'] uppercase, not 'buy' lowercase → corrected. Both were test-script bugs, not product bugs.
